mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_ID, USER_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PRICE, PRODUCT_CATEGORY, DESCRIPTION, PRODUCT_ADDRESS, PRODUCT_LAT, PRODUCT_LNG, PRODUCT_PLACE_ID, PRODUCT_REGDATE ) VALUES ( PRODUCT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{productCategory}, #{description}, #{productAddress}, #{productLat}, #{productLng}, #{productPlaceId}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(PRODUCT_ID) FROM PRODUCT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
SELECT * FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY PRODUCT_REGDATE DESC
